title: You arrive home.
paragraphs: The front door sticks like it always does. You kick it shut behind you and drop your bag in the hallway.
Your bank app says €10. Payday is seven nights away.
You open the shared fridge. Your shelf holds half a lemon and a bottle of ketchup. The other three shelves are full.

title: Sanne
paragraphs: Sanne is at the kitchen table with a label maker. Every jar on her shelf has her initial on it.
"Six eggs, two yoghurts, one block of cheese," she mutters, writing it all down. "Just so I know."
She looks up and smiles. "Welcome home!"

title: Mo
paragraphs: Mo comes in carrying a paper bag from the organic market. He unpacks it slowly, like a museum curator.
"Real butter. Proper parmesan. Once you've tasted the good stuff, you can't go back."
He sniffs a tomato and nods to himself. "I'd notice the cheap stuff straight away. Always."

title: Lisa
paragraphs: Lisa barely looks up from her phone. Her shelf is a mess of half-eaten snacks and things past their date.
"Take whatever, honestly. I don't keep track."
Then, without looking up: "Except for one thing. You'll know it when you see it."

title: The house goes quiet.
paragraphs: One by one, the bedroom doors close. Your stomach growls.
Seven nights. Three full shelves. Don't get caught.
